findings.current: Three Supreme Peak masters—or hundreds of people and ships—must have been mobilized.
findings.defect: The source says more than several hundred people and vessels, but the translation reduces this to merely hundreds.
findings.rationale: 수백이 넘는 explicitly exceeds several hundred; the current wording weakens the stated quantity.
findings.replacement: Three Supreme Peak masters—or more than several hundred people and ships—must have been mobilized.

findings.current: Hundreds of large ships travel the Hubei stretch of the Yangtze every day
findings.defect: The translation drops the source's explicit 'more than several hundred' quantity.
findings.rationale: 수백 척이 넘는 means more than several hundred vessels, not simply hundreds.
findings.replacement: More than several hundred large ships travel the Hubei stretch of the Yangtze every day

findings.current: the Three Fiends was closer to a beast wearing human skin
findings.defect: “Wearing human skin” adds a literal skin-as-covering image that the source does not establish.
findings.rationale: 사람의 모습을 한 means having a human appearance or form; it does not specify human skin as a physical covering.
findings.replacement: the Three Fiends was closer to a beast in human form

summary: Mostly faithful, with two quantity weakenings and one added physical implication.
